#!/bin/sh -x

. "${0%/*}/setup" "$@"

PATH=$JQBASEDIR:$PATH $JQBASEDIR/tests/jq-f-test.sh > /dev/null

  libinject=$JQBASEDIR/.libs/libinject_errors.so

  touch fail_read

  true
  )
fi

$VALGRIND $Q $JQ -Rse '. == "a\u0000b\nc\u0000d\ne"' $d/input
